annotations.text:
Report visual polish — aspirational targets.
Three archetypes the module should render beautifully from the same section vocabulary (kpi, chart, table, filter, markdown, download). Everything shown maps to a section the spec already has, except where a note says otherwise. Light theme; series palette (green, purple, amber, blue) is CVD-validated against the surface. Sample data is fictional.

Dashboard: KPI band + chart grid.
Filters dock in one row (max 3), the KPI band answers first, then a 7/5 chart row, a full-width trend, one table. Bars sort value-descending with direct value labels; the multi-series line carries a legend plus end labels. Proposed additions to today's renderer: side-by-side section widths (7/5 split) and the quiet delta caption on KPI tiles — both flagged for the design pass.

Narrative report: markdown-led single column.
A generate_report composition that reads like a document: serif prose interleaved with a hero KPI, figures sized to the text measure, numbered figure labels, and a compact table. Everything here exists in the contract today (markdown + kpi + chart + table + download) — the polish is measure, rhythm, and the centered paper surface.

Dense operational view: the table is the report.
Compact header, filters, a divider-strip of six KPIs (not six cards), a small-multiples strip (same measure, per-panel scale, one hue), then a dense grid sorted by urgency. The amber ink on the overdue count is the only accent — status color reserved for state, never decoration.
